title: Bijectivity of the transferred rank-one functional
statement: Let k be a field, V and W k-vector spaces, and W finite-dimensional with finrank k W = 1. Let n ∈ k be nonzero and R : V →ₗ[k] W, C : W →ₗ[k] V satisfy C(Rv) = n·v for every v. If ℓ : V →ₗ[k] k is surjective, then ℓ ∘ C : W →ₗ[k] k is bijective. No finite-dimensionality assumption on V is required.
lean_statement: ∀ {k V W : Type} [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [FiniteDimensional k W] (n : k) (hn : n ≠ 0) (R : V →ₗ[k] W) (C : W →ₗ[k] V), (∀ v : V, C (R v) = n • v) → Module.finrank k W = 1 → ∀ ℓ : V →ₗ[k] k, Function.Surjective ℓ → Function.Bijective (ℓ.comp C)
